report:
Reviewed meta.reviews.input_format's complete claim, associated review.rs implementation, and all seven associated tests. This was source inspection; no behavior tests were executed by this reviewer. Central suite execution remains separate evidence.

ReviewInput defines exactly prompt, coordinator_instructions, fragments, implementations and tests, with unknown fields rejected on deserialization. inventory assigns the exact PROMPT, creates claim/whole-implementation-file/semantic-test InputFragments and copies complete association identity, cfg, excerpt/region/explanation where applicable, and declared status into separately ordered metadata vectors. start replaces coordinator_instructions with the supplied ordered vector without rewriting strings, writes that same input and returns it. capture_read appends another InputFragment to the existing collection and preserves the initial fragments and metadata. Source strings use reversible newline splitting. Captured correspondence/evidence helpers establish eligible-test metadata, implementation regions and inherited cfg/status; captured shared check code confirms accepting a report does not rewrite TODO/N/A into ordinary status.

Every associated test was inspected. initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments asserts exact ordered instructions (including embedded newline), exact prompt, returned-versus-saved input equality, claim path/text, entire implementation text, semantic test text, absence of whole-file test substitution and association counts. input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection asserts every implementation metadata field, test identity/cfg/status, preserved initial arrays after an extra read, one appended exact fragment and exactly the five schema keys. region_association_preserves_placeholder_explanation_and_excerpt checks region=true, enclosing TODO module/status, retained prerequisite explanation/excerpt and saved metadata equality. accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence checks both placeholder classes on implementation/test sides, explanations, accepted validation and zero ordinary approvals with the correct separate placeholder counts.

added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments requires failures for adding/removing tests and adding implementation metadata, plus a complete deterministic refreshed set preserving the original record. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement asserts crate/target/path/file/inherited cfg/status, exact semantic source capture, acceptance after unrelated line movement and rejection after inherited cfg changes with identical test text. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits exercises CRLF blank lines, LF and unterminated final line, exact range results, invalid range rejection, selection-sensitive freshness, repeated identical appended fragments and joined-content equality, and trailing-newline freshness. Captured Fixture/TEST helpers create actual workspace and persisted review files; meaningful assertions remain visible in each annotated body.

Together these cover all five fields, exact prompt and instruction ordering, initial and later source context in one representation, full association metadata and preserved declared status. No TODO/N/A evidence is associated with this anchor itself; placeholder statuses in its tests are scenarios being asserted. No concrete defect or additional required source change was found. Requested edits are empty.
